dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave curvature on the trailing edge, featuring a distinct irregular notch located approximately one-third of the way up from the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded apex with a large pixel radius, exhibiting an obtuse geometric classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Smoothly convex anterior margin rising at approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep V-shaped indentation/notch on the lower trailing edge and several faint, parallel horizontal linear rake marks on the upper leading edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized water splashing and droplet formation visible at the anterior base where the fin breaks the waterline.
